name: rsi_divergence_vwap_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP selling programs execute in size bursts separated by absorption pauses: the index makes a new 1-minute low yet RSI (measuring momentum velocity, not price) fails to confirm because resting buy orders at each lower tick partially absorb the selling. This momentum-price divergence signals that the marginal seller is nearly exhausted. When NIFTY is also within 0.15% below session VWAP, VWAP-benchmarked algorithms — which receive adverse fills below their benchmark — begin accelerating accumulation, creating a 30-90 second demand surge that reverts price toward VWAP. The entry fires at the moment the divergence is detectable (2-minute window comparison) while the demand response is just beginning.

indicators.name: rsi_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute RSI at 5s bars. Original used RSI(14) on 1-min = 14-minute momentum window. We do NOT scale 12x (that would give RSI(168) = 14-minute lookback at 5s which measures the wrong timescale). Instead we choose 24 bars (2 min) because we're trading micro-bounces with 30-90s hold time — the RSI must be responsive enough to reflect intrabar momentum pauses, not multi-hour trends. 24 bars provides enough smoothing to distinguish genuine absorption from tick noise.

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each session
indicators.purpose: Cumulative session VWAP — no scaling needed as it is a cumulative measure without a fixed lookback. Same role as original: price anchor for VWAP-benchmarked institutional algos. On NIFTY, the proximity threshold is tightened to 0.15% (vs original 1.0% on stocks) because the index is 5-10x less volatile per unit and VWAP algos defend much narrower deviations.

indicators.name: divergence_recent_window
indicators.formula: argmin/argmax(close, bars i-12:i) and RSI at that index
indicators.purpose: 1-minute recent window (12 x 5s = 60s) to find the latest price extreme and its RSI. 12 bars chosen because a micro-swing on NIFTY at 5s resolution typically completes in 45-75 seconds; this window captures one full micro-swing without excessive lag at entry.

indicators.name: divergence_prior_window
indicators.formula: argmin/argmax(close, bars i-24:i-12) and RSI at that index
indicators.purpose: 1-minute prior window for comparison. Total divergence pattern spans 2 minutes (24 bars), matching the 30-90s hold time. We enter when the pattern just completed — the reversion is beginning — not after the full recovery. Original pattern spanned ~25 bars of 1-min (25 min), analogously we use 24 bars of 5s (2 min).

conditions: recent_min_price < prior_min_price (NIFTY lower price low in last 2 min)
recent_min_rsi > prior_min_rsi (RSI higher low — momentum divergence confirmed)
vwap_distance in (-0.15%, -0.01%) — just below VWAP where demand floor activates
rsi_24 < 45 (still in oversold-to-neutral zone, bounce not yet started)
vix < 22 (avoid high-vol regimes where divergences extend without resolving)
buy_ce.confirmation: All conditions true on current 5s bar

conditions: recent_max_price > prior_max_price (NIFTY higher price high in last 2 min)
recent_max_rsi < prior_max_rsi (RSI lower high — momentum divergence confirmed)
vwap_distance in (0.01%, 0.15%) — just above VWAP where supply floor activates
rsi_24 > 55 (still in overbought-to-neutral zone, fade not yet started)
vix < 22 (avoid high-vol regimes where divergences extend without resolving)
buy_pe.confirmation: All conditions true on current 5s bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points (~8 NIFTY spot points at ATM delta ~0.5). If NIFTY moves 8 additional spot points against the entry after divergence detection, the absorption pattern has failed and momentum has reasserted — within NIFTY's 30s typical range of 2-5 option pts, a 4-pt adverse move is a clean structural invalidation. Tighter than deep-reversion strategies because divergence entries have a specific timing thesis.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points (~14 NIFTY spot points). Entering 0.05-0.15% below VWAP at NIFTY 22000 is approximately 11-33 spot pts; VWAP touch captures 11-33 pts → 5.5-16.5 option pts. Target of 7 pts captures the lower half of that range with high probability, fitting within NIFTY's 60s typical move of 3-7 option pts at the upper bound.

filters.vix_filter: vix < 22 — same threshold as original; above 22, divergences on NIFTY extend for multiple minutes rather than resolving within 90s
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST — skip first 15 min for VWAP to stabilize (need at least 15 min of cumulative volume for VWAP to be meaningful) and avoid opening-range volatility
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume at 5s is too noisy for per-bar filters; VWAP proximity acts as implicit liquidity proxy
filters.trend_filter: implicit via VWAP distance: bullish divergences only below VWAP, bearish only above VWAP
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at close prices eliminates spread concern

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — divergence-based exhaustion is structural to how TWAP algos execute but NIFTY micro-divergences at 2-min are noisy; false signal rate will be significant

adaptation_notes: RSI(14) on 1-min → RSI(24) on 5s (2 min): NOT 12x scaled (that gives RSI(168) measuring 14-min momentum, irrelevant for 30-90s hold). Compressed to 2 min to match hold time. Divergence window: original 25-bar 1-min pivots (25 min) → 24-bar 5s windows (2 min), matching hold time analogy. VWAP proximity threshold: original -1% to 0% on individual stocks → tightened to -0.15% to -0.01% on NIFTY because the index oscillates in much narrower percentage bands and VWAP-benchmarked demand activates at smaller deviations. Hold time compressed from 15-60 min to 30-90s: trading the fast initial absorption response, not the full VWAP recovery. Removed per-stock volume filter (index volume too noisy at 5s). Removed trailing stop (inappropriate for sub-2-minute holds).
weaknesses: 2-minute divergence detection at 5s is inherently noisy — NIFTY micro-swings are driven by order routing artifacts as much as genuine buying exhaustion
Tight VWAP proximity filter (0.01-0.15%) severely limits trade frequency in trending sessions where NIFTY stays away from VWAP for hours
Original profit factor was 1.10 on individual stocks with full discretionary confirmation; index version without confirmation likely has lower base win rate
